messages:
Maya CSM: Kicking off Neptune Labs private deployment onboarding. Main focus: VPC peering vs PrivateLink, IAM role mapping, KMS key access, and audit logs. Can @Priya confirm network window and any compliance constraints?
Priya (Neptune - NetEng): Thanks Maya — we have a maintenance window next Tue 01:00–03:00 UTC. Compliance requires CMEK for model keys and CloudTrail delivery to their locked S3 bucket (no public access).
Luca (SE): Great — for throughput-sensitive inference we usually recommend VPC Peering + route table for lower latency. PrivateLink is OK if they need strict endpoint isolation. Which EKS/VM region are they in?
Priya (Neptune - NetEng): Primary in us-east-1, failover in us-west-2. We prefer PrivateLink for cross-account traffic restrictions, but worried about per-connection throughput.
Tom Infra: PrivateLink throughput should be fine for control plane and small telemetry. For high-volume token streaming, peering gives fewer hops. We can propose hybrid: peering for data plane, PrivateLink for control plane + KMS requests.
Maya CSM: Hybrid sounds sensible. Action items: (1) draft network diagram; (2) provide IAM role trust sample for cross-account infra role; (3) KMS key policy snippet for Redwood service principal; (4) verify CloudTrail to locked S3.
Luca (SE): IAM example below — customer should create a role in their acct with this trust for Redwood's management principal:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDSRV:role/redwood-inference"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceAccount": "CUSTOMER_ACCT_ID"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
Luca (SE): Replace REDSRV/CUSTOMER_ACCT_ID with actual ARNs. Also attach least-privilege policy for KMS and S3 put/get as needed.
Priya (Neptune - NetEng): For KMS we need an explicit key policy. Can you show the minimal allow for decrypt/encrypt by the role above?
Tom Infra: KMS snippet (minimal):```json
{
  "Id": "key-policy-1",
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodRole",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDSRV:role/redwood-inference"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
Tom Infra: Note: we recommend Customer also adds a condition limiting use to the Redwood service VPC endpoints for extra safety.
Maya CSM: Re: audit logs — we need CloudTrail configured to send Management & Data events to their secure S3 prefix. Neptune team: please confirm the bucket ARN and whether logs need to be retained for 7 or 90 days.
Priya (Neptune - NetEng): Bucket ARN is arn:aws:s3:::neptune-audit-logs, retention 90 days, object lock enabled. We'll share bucket policy and full network diagram later today.
Luca (SE): One more: for prefix/KV caching we will need consistent source IPs. If using PrivateLink, make sure NAT/egress IPs are assigned and shared with us so we can whitelist.
Priya (Neptune - NetEng): Noted — will provide egress IPs and VPC flow logs if useful.
Maya CSM: I'll compile action items and send a short runbook. Tom/Luca — can you draft the minimal IAM + KMS + S3 policy templates by EOD?
Tom Infra: On it, will attach templates to the shared ticket.
Luca (SE): I'll draft network sketch and PrivateLink vs peering pros/cons doc.
Priya (Neptune - NetEng): Thanks all — will aim to have diagrams and bucket policy by 18:00 UTC.
auditbot: Ticket CS-1249 created: "Neptune Labs private deploy — network/iam/kms onboarding" assigned to Maya CSM, Tom Infra, Luca (SE).
Maya CSM: Perfect. I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Mon 15:00 UTC to review templates. :calendar: :thumbsup:
